title: Pln1 Mediates Lipid Droplet-Vacuole Tethering During Microlipophagy in Saccharomyces cerevisiae
authors: Rao MJ; Folger B; Reus J; Toulmay A; Li J; Zhang R; Prinz W; Goodman J; Wang F
one_liner_zh: 该文研究酵母脂滴蛋白Pln1通过其IDR介导脂滴-液泡锚定以促进微脂自噬，虽涉及IDR在膜器互作中的功能，但对象为脂滴-液泡而非蛋白-蛋白互作，且方法为实验遗传学，无AI/物理模拟建模，故仅部分相关。
abstract: Lipid droplets (LDs) are dynamic organelles that undergo growth or degradation depending on the metabolic state of the cell. One form of LD degradation is autophagy-mediated, referred to as lipophagy. Here, we demonstrate that Pln1, a perilipin located on the surface of LDs in Saccharomyces cerevisiae , previously known for its role in LD biogenesis, is essential for lipophagy. Pln1 facilitates the docking of cytosolic LDs to vacuoles, the lysosome-like organelles responsible for LD degradation, under various nutrient conditions. Molecular dissection of Pln1 revealed that the N-terminal PAT (Perilipin (PLN1), Adipophilin (PLN2), and TIP47 (PLN3)) domain and a hydrophobic region are critical for the localization and binding of LDs to vacuoles. Site-specific mutagenesis within the PAT domain identified a semi-hydrophobic LD Interacting Motif (LIM), which is vital for this interaction. Furthermore, an intrinsically disordered region (IDR) near the center of Pln1 is required for efficient LD-vacuole tethering. These findings support a model in which Pln1 bridges LDs and vacuoles by simultaneously interacting with both organelles. Notably, deleting PLN1 did not impair survival during prolonged nitrogen starvation and enhanced viability in autophagy-defective ( atg8 Δ) cells, suggesting that balancing Pln1-mediated LD biogenesis and lipophagy is crucial for yeast survival under starvation conditions.
abstract_zh: 脂滴（LDs）是动态细胞器，其生长或降解取决于细胞的代谢状态。脂滴降解的一种形式是自噬介导的，称为脂噬。在此，我们证明Pln1，一种位于酿酒酵母脂滴表面的围脂滴蛋白，先前已知其在脂滴生物发生中的作用，对于脂噬是必需的。Pln1在各种营养条件下促进胞质脂滴对接至液泡，即负责脂滴降解的类溶酶体细胞器。对Pln1的分子解析揭示，N端PAT（围脂滴蛋白（PLN1）、脂肪分化相关蛋白（PLN2）和TIP47（PLN3））结构域及一个疏水区域对于脂滴的定位和与液泡的结合至关重要。在PAT结构域内的位点特异性突变鉴定出一个半疏水性脂滴相互作用基序（LIM），该基序对此相互作用至关重要。此外，Pln1中心附近的一个固有无序区域（IDR）对于高效的脂滴-液泡拴系是必需的。这些发现支持一个模型，即Pln1通过同时与两种细胞器相互作用来桥接脂滴和液泡。值得注意的是，删除PLN1并未损害长期氮饥饿期间的生存，并增强了自噬缺陷（atg8Δ）细胞的活力，表明平衡Pln1介导的脂滴生物发生和脂噬对于酵母在饥饿条件下的生存至关重要。
